name: Nogg
summary: In Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor, Nogg puts his craft to work for the Horde. He studies strange mechanical salvage from deep within Gnomeregan.

sections.title: Nogg's Workshop
sections.body: Nogg keeps an independent engineering workshop in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. Adventurers and craftsmen seek the mechanical skill of a goblin in a city famed for orcish steel and strength. He eagerly examines unusual devices and trinkets brought from Alliance lands or underground ruins.

sections.title: Gnomish Gadgets and Salvage
sections.body: Salvage from Gnomeregan draws Nogg's special attention. Horde operatives recover intricate rings and other remnants from the fallen gnomish capital. Few minds in Durotar can take apart those strange clockwork devices, decipher them, and adapt them for Horde use.

faq.answer: Nogg works from his engineering workshop in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.

faq.q: What is Nogg's connection to Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: Horde adventurers salvage intricate devices from Gnomeregan's irradiated tunnels in Khaz Modan. Nogg inspects and reconfigures the gnomish rings they bring back.

faq.q: Is Nogg part of the Horde?
faq.answer: Nogg is an independent goblin artisan in Orgrimmar who serves Horde adventurers with his technical skill.

faq.q: Can Nogg alter or reforge rings?
faq.answer: Yes. Bring Nogg a Sparklematic-extracted ring from Gnomeregan, and he can dismantle and rebuild it with different enchantments or mechanical properties.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can visit Nogg's workshop in the Valley of Honor for parts and talk. You can also watch him repurpose intricate gnomish devices with ease.
As a Horde warrior returning from dangerous operations in the Eastern Kingdoms, you can bring Nogg crude salvage. He can turn it into finely calibrated battle gear.
